rics.meaning: Retail Sales, year-over-year change — Bank Indonesia's monthly Retail Sales Survey result. Released ~6 weeks after month-end.
rics.how_to_use: Most-watched Indonesia retail-demand gauge. Recent YoY ~3-5%. Surges around Lebaran-Eid month. Decompose by category (food, clothing, automotive, fuel) for cyclical-mix signal. Pair with consumer confidence (aIDCONCF) for triangulated read.

rics.meaning: Retail Sales Total Index (rebased) — BI Retail Sales Survey level. Tracks aggregate sales across major retailers.
rics.how_to_use: Use the YoY series (aIDRSLSAR) for trend; level for analytical baseline. Indonesia retail surveys are broad (food + non-food combined) — narrower than US-style retail-control concepts.
